payload.title: File:Yacarerani.jpg
payload.description_html:
Life restoration of Yacarerani boliviensis.
  • Head based on this figure from "Bizarre notosuchian crocodyliform with associated eggs from the Upper Cretaceous of Bolivia" by Fernando E. Novas, Diego F. Pais, Diego Pol, Ismar De Souza Carvalho, Agustin Scanferla, Alvaro Mones, and Mario Suárez Riglos Journal of Vertebrate Paleontology 29 (4) and the first photograph in this news article.
  • Body based on general notosuchian morphology.
